headline: Domino's® Serves Up Summer Savings: All Menu-Priced Pizzas Are 50% Off July 27-Aug. 2
summary: Summer just got a whole lot tastier. Domino's Pizza Inc. (Nasdaq: DPZ) is helping customers make the most of the season by offering 50% off all menu-priced pizzas from July 27-Aug. 2.
